# API contract v1

## Progressive product extension

The active scope and shared contracts are [PRODUCT_SPEC.md](PRODUCT_SPEC.md) and [PRODUCT_PLAN.md](PRODUCT_PLAN.md). Existing source/scene/download routes remain compatible; `/api/ask` remains a synchronous reviewed-answer route. The browser uses these additions:

- Upload returns `building_id`, `revision_id`, monotonic `revision_number`, `review_status`, `has_scene`, `unresolved_views` and `is_new_upload`. Building identity is a SHA-256 of original uploaded bytes. Only genuinely new drawing uploads automatically start a job in the UI; reopening/reuploading does not start inference.
- `GET /api/buildings` returns `{buildings:[document_public]}`. `GET /api/buildings/{id}` returns that public record plus saved jobs, newest first.
- `POST /api/buildings/{id}/reconstruction` accepts `{base_revision_id,mode:"refine"|"reconstruct"}` and returns a job with HTTP202. Genuine native IFC is never automatically reconstructed. Existing usable models require local/source replacement checks before publication; fresh supported sources publish an early preview.
- `POST /api/questions` accepts `{document_id,question,revision_id?,request_id?}` and returns HTTP202 with a revision-pinned job. `GET /api/jobs/{id}` reports persisted progress and, after successful QA, `answer`. `POST /api/jobs/{id}/stop` prevents late publication; an in-flight provider call may still finish.
- Jobs distinguish queued/running/complete/needs_attention/failed/budget_exhausted/stopped/interrupted. API or schema failures never become source insufficiency. A failed correction leaves the usable revision intact.
- `GET /api/buildings/{id}/revisions/{revision}/evidence/{object_id}` returns a faithful native IFC record plus coverage for that exact saved revision, including non-rendered semantic records. Drawing-derived IFC is rejected on this native evidence path and continues to use original page regions.
- Answers add `building_id`, `answered_revision_id`, `display_revision_id`, support-review metadata and source-bound calculation results. Highlights are revalidated after concurrent reconstruction; original citations survive missing mappings.
- Portable artifact v4 preserves exact description, server-owned identities/tombstones and source frames. V2/V3 remain readable. Ordinary bbox changes cannot move frames; supported calibration/orientation changes require explicit evidence-backed updates. Concept proposals never enter these artifacts or reasoning records.

Below is the historical initial API contract; the extension above supersedes temporary-session and pre-review behavior.

Current drawing reconstruction is specified in [RECONSTRUCTION_V3_PLAN.md](RECONSTRUCTION_V3_PLAN.md) and [RECONSTRUCTION_V3_CONTRACT.md](RECONSTRUCTION_V3_CONTRACT.md). These supersede historical single-floor/relative-only restrictions; core evidence and provider invariants remain.

Root owns this contract; agents coordinate before changes. JSON uses snake_case.

The implemented 3D extension is specified in [3D_CONTRACT.md](3D_CONTRACT.md). Upload also accepts uncompressed IFC up to25MiB, with `kind` and `scene_url` fields; health adds `max_ifc_mb:25`. Answers add `highlight_ids` and `model_evidence`; IFC uses source records rather than page images. Existing drawing fields below remain compatible.

## Endpoints
- `GET /api/health`: `{status:"ok",provider_ready:bool,model:str,decision_model:str,limits:{max_upload_mb:10,max_pages:5}}`. Readiness means credentials/config exist, not verified provider access. No secrets.
- `POST /api/documents` multipart `file` (JPG/PNG/PDF, max 10 MiB, max 5 pages; reject larger documents rather than silently truncate). Returns `{document_id,filename,pages:[{page:1,width,height,image_url}],warnings:[]}`. Images are re-encoded PNG, PDF pages rendered. Opaque server-generated IDs; no filesystem paths.
- `GET /api/documents/{id}/pages/{page}` returns preview PNG.
- `POST /api/ask` JSON `{document_id,question}`. Question trimmed, 1–2000 chars. Returns Answer below.
- Standard errors: `{detail:"safe actionable message"}`; validation errors may be FastAPI detail arrays. API failures are 502/503, not insufficiency. Missing documents 404.

## Answer
```
{
  "status": "answered|insufficient|unclear",
  "answer": "human readable factual answer or scoped limitation",
  "evidence": [{"page":1,"bbox":[0.1,0.2,0.4,0.5],"label":"Bedroom label","observation":"MH annotation"}],
  "missing_information": ["Ceiling height"],
  "next_action": "Upload a section drawing with height dimensions.",
  "proposal": null,
  "inspected_pages": [1],
  "gate": {"decision":"sufficient|insufficient|unclear","confidence":0.8},
  "inspection_passes": 1,
  "usage": {"input_tokens":0,"output_tokens":0,"latency_ms":0}
}
```
`bbox` is [left,top,right,bottom], normalized 0–1 in the original displayed page. Validate positive area and page existence. Proposal if present: `{text, basis:"explicit_assumption|reference",reference:null|string}`. No invented reference buildings. Model-generated evidence is an aid to inspection, not a verified detection guarantee. Scores are model signals, not probabilities of factual correctness. `gate.confidence` is nullable: OpenAI's temporary structured classification returns null instead of inventing a confidence score.

Provider selection: `AI_PROVIDER=gemini|openai`, default gemini. Health additionally returns `provider`, `provider_label`, `credential_env`, `gate_kind` (`gemini_decisions|structured_classification`). For OpenAI, `decision_model` is the same configured `OPENAI_MODEL` used to generate the three-way classification. Missing/invalid configuration fails explicitly; no automatic fallback. The final demo must select Gemini.

## Provider orchestration
One overall Decisions choice on source pages + question. `unclear` allows one bounded targeted second inspection (a real crop/higher-resolution source view), then rerun the same gate with expanded evidence. Do not re-ask identical input and call it inspection. Standard Gemini explains limitations or generates a structured answer against original sources; never turn a negative gate into a factual answer. A positive gate does not force an answer when generation reveals missing evidence. Answer citations must validate; absent/invalid evidence cannot be silently accepted. # Source-first iteration implementation plan

Status: independently reviewed and approved in round 1; no planning blockers. Reviewer explicitly confirmed source/revision compatibility, optional geometry, unknown-scale supplied heights, cached append, artifact portability and actual-IFC elevation requirements. This plan implements all twelve authoritative attachment requirements; it supersedes older single-source, automatic-reconstruction, new-format exclusion and no-commit instructions where the newer user request differs. Gemini and its configurable reconstruction model remain unchanged. Focused milestone commits are authorized; pushes are not.

## Scope and design choices

Keep the existing one-process FastAPI, plain browser JavaScript, filesystem bundles, original evidence, shared description, deterministic IfcOpenShell generator, reviewed QA and concept renderer. Add automatic source interpretation, explicitly requested optional geometry, incremental multi-source buildings, source-linked conversation/clarification, editable attributed values, coherent floor presentation, diagnostics and a separate format adapter track. Preserve V2–V4 artifacts and saved bundles.

No arbitrary source/object/vertex cap is proposed. Existing per-file normalization/provider/job limits remain visible and must be reported individually; do not reinterpret the historical five-page per-file bound as a five-page whole-building bound. Existing 25 MiB portable IFC bound may prevent embedding large multi-source sets: report that export limitation without losing the local bundle or blocking QA. Existing configured correction/call budgets remain; extraction alone must not spend reconstruction-review/repair calls. Root must communicate any necessary changed budget before live calls. Local resource isolation for SVG/DXF protects the renderer from active content/external resources; it can reject drawings relying on external assets, so report unsupported features explicitly. These are implementation choices, not claims about source validity.

Exclude detailed roofs/domes, photorealism, Blender/cloud rendering, auth/database and autonomous runtime agents. Unknown geometry stays unresolved. SVG and DXF are now included; DWG support depends on an actually verified converter and must never be advertised speculatively.

## Shared contracts (freeze before dependent implementation)

### Source identity and revision membership

A building keeps its existing 64-hex `building_id` (initial source hash); adding files never changes it. A `source_id` is SHA256 of original bytes, independent of filename. Source metadata includes original bytes/hash, display filename aliases, media kind, normalized page hashes/dimensions, normalization mapping/diagnostics and optional vector metadata. Deduplicate resources and successful interpretation by source identity, including reuse across buildings; do not reuse a source result conditioned on another building's context as independent extraction.

Each immutable revision saves a `sources` manifest. Entries map `(source_id, source_page)` to an append-only building `page` number, with the original normalized page pixels and coordinate mapping. Never renumber earlier pages. Internal `Page` and public page descriptors add `source_id`, `source_page` and source filename; existing `page` remains the canonical legacy selector. A source extraction cache uses source-local pages; merge explicitly remaps every source reference into the building page namespace and assigns building-stable object IDs. Geometry/review caches are keyed to their input revision, not merely original file hash.

References retain existing `{page,bbox}` and add optional `source_id`/`source_page`; server resolves legacy refs against that revision's manifest and rejects conflicting combinations. Every normalized bbox remains in the displayed original page frame, never the building frame. New evidence URLs are revision-pinned; existing unversioned routes remain compatibility/current routes. An older answer resolves its own source manifest, not CURRENT's source list. Legacy bundles synthesize one source entry on load without rewriting old revisions.

Native IFC keeps original GlobalId/property evidence per `source_id`; model record identity must include source identity when different IFCs repeat a GlobalId. Drawing-derived IFC restores drawing sources and cannot enter native factual shortcuts. Multi-source drawing ingestion is the main UI flow; mixed/native source catalogs retain per-record evidence rules rather than converting native objects to floor polygons. Never silently overwrite or fuse conflicting source facts.

### Shared interpretation with optional geometry

Extend `BuildingDescription` additively, not with a second incompatible reasoning pipeline. Retain floors, original labels, source refs and existing persistent IDs. Allow semantic records without geometric traces: empty/absent polygon/segment fields mean geometry unavailable, not empty evidence. Add source-linked observations/measurements for all view types, including section/elevation facts; only actual floor plans instantiate floor geometry. Expose extraction coverage and per-source completion. Preserve exact returned validated interpretation before any generator call.

Provider interface: `extract_interpretation(document, *, include_geometry=False)` returns the shared schema. The source-first prompt requests useful semantic observations, view classification, labels, measurements and evidence regions without exhaustive wall/feature polygon tracing. Geometry action reuses that interpretation and requests only missing geometry/relationships through the same schema and typed patch workflow; existing full descriptions require no re-extraction. Existing `reconstruct` may remain a compatibility wrapper. Reasoning object/floor records derive from saved interpretation independent of scene; optional scene associations enrich them without becoming factual evidence.

Source extraction operates independently per new source so adding B does not re-extract A. Building integration combines cached source interpretations deterministically; repeated views of a floor must not silently create additional storeys. Merge only source-supported floor equivalences, retain all supporting refs, and mark uncertain alternatives/conflicting dimensions explicitly. Explicit geometry/refinement can inspect multiple originals for cross-source relationships/conflicts. Persist interpretation identity/provenance and missing geometry; no geometry work or reconstruction review on default extraction. Missing interpretation records never establish missing source objects.

Revision payload adds `interpretation_status`, `geometry_status`, and `geometry_revision_id` where retained geometry belongs to an older interpretation. QA pins the current source/interpretation revision; UI explicitly identifies any retained older model, and highlights only validated associations. Publication of extraction must never relabel an older scene as regenerated against new evidence. Successful JSON survives a geometry error, restart or stop. Source-only revisions are first-class successes.

### Jobs, atomicity and APIs

Keep current routes. `POST /api/documents` accepts existing `file` and additive multi-file `files`; source-first upload queues automatic extraction server-side for genuinely uncached drawing sources. `POST /api/buildings/{id}/sources` adds related files to the selected building. Return source list, per-source statuses, extraction job IDs, revision identity and `has_scene`. A duplicate upload/reopen returns cached state without inference; interrupted or failed extraction requires an explicit retry, not surprise reprocessing.

Add `POST /api/buildings/{id}/extraction` for explicit retry. Existing reconstruction endpoint is the explicit Generate 3D/Refine action. Coalesce repeated requests for the same source/operation. Persist source additions before launching inference. Workers extract against immutable source snapshots and save cache results even if their publication base became stale. Under the store lock, merge an unchanged per-source result into the newest source manifest; if related interpretation/user values changed, preserve the candidate and require a deliberate rebase/review. Geometry/refinement still uses compare-and-swap on base revision. No worker may drop newly appended sources or user edits. Stop/restart guards prevent late publication.

Job diagnostics persist `phase`, safe `error_stage`, `error_category`, opaque diagnostic ID, usage and whether a prior model actually exists. Stages distinguish ingestion, extraction provider, interpretation validation, geometry enrichment, IFC generation, reopening and review. Save returned structured outputs privately for deterministic replay; never log raw requests, credentials, source content or provider exception strings. First-model failure says sources/interpretation were saved and no model was generated; only say retained model when one exists.

### Conversation and clarification

Persist conversation messages within the building bundle, each with ID, role, timestamp, input/question, revision, job ID and final result. `AskRequest` adds optional `conversation_id`, `reply_to` and structured `clarification_response`; old callers remain supported. Client sends a message reference, not untrusted assistant evidence. Server retrieves relevant prior turns and explicit selected scope as fallible conversational context; originals and current revision provide factual support.

Question jobs may complete with a distinct typed `clarification` result `{message, suggestions, free_text_allowed:true, reply_to}` rather than an `insufficient` answer. Resolve materially ambiguous intent before the evidence gate, using a small provider intent-routing response; do not impose clarification when a stated reasonable scope suffices. Reuse existing question execution budget and expose this call in usage. Source insufficiency remains the three-way sufficiency gate. Clarification replies preserve intent context without treating earlier assistant assertions as sources.

Final answers retain reviewed status, original citations, native records, calculations, uncertainty and review outcome. UI shows meaningful phases and an expandable Evidence and checks view, never private chain-of-thought or unreviewed drafts. Chat citations load the answered revision's source even without 3D; conservative object links respect current view and preserve camera/orbit. Old messages remain accessible after revision changes and restart.

### Editable attributed inputs

Add immutable revision `user_values` records with ID, scope `{floor_id?,object_id?}`, property, typed value/unit, provenance `user_provided`, optional original evidence/source document ref, reason, base revision and submission identity. Shared assumption rows are computed/grouped by scope+property; distinguish `observed`, `inferred`, `display_assumption`, `unknown`, `user_provided` without changing observed source facts in place. A supplied height never calibrates XY. With unknown horizontal scale, retain the actual supplied height and unit for attributed QA, keep the scene unscaled, and disclose the separate display conversion used for vertical presentation; never treat relative plan units as metres.

`GET /api/buildings/{id}/assumptions` returns grouped rows and editable property descriptors. `POST /api/buildings/{id}/refinements` accepts `{base_revision_id, edits:[...], supporting_source_ids?:[...]}` and returns a job. Validate finite values, supported unit dimensions, scope, source refs and revision before publication; reject executable/arbitrary paths. Supported properties cover storey display/known height, source-referenced plan calibration, stair connectivity and source-linked interpretation corrections through typed patches. Ambiguous corrections remain reviewable inputs, not assumed facts. Do not silently ignore unsupported properties.

Apply and refine persists submitted provenance, assesses source conflicts, changes affected deterministic geometry or uses bounded targeted model review where interpretation is required, then atomically publishes accepted updates. Failed candidates retain submitted values/diagnostics separately plus the prior usable revision. No call on editing/keystrokes. Exports/reopen preserve user values, edits and source identity in additive versioned artifact metadata with V2–V4 readers retained. The new artifact manifest also embeds original source bytes with hash/media kind, normalized pages and source-local mappings/vector metadata, so reopening preserves supplied SVG/DXF originals as well as visual evidence. Existing artifact-size validation remains; if the portable artifact cannot contain these sources, report that export as unavailable while retaining the complete local bundle rather than exporting provenance loss. QA can use user values with explicit attribution for appropriate questions, but drawing-only height questions still refuse unsupported source facts.

### Geometry and viewer

Keep three transforms separate: original page→local floor plane, local floor→building placement/elevation, and viewer-only exploded spacing. Preserve frozen source frames and shared-page scale. Permit supported registration in an unscaled common page frame without asserting metres: matching stair/exterior anchors with inspected evidence can establish translation/rotation; never independently scale floors or equalize footprints. Cross-page scale uncertainty remains explicit. Add source-linked registration/stair relationships with status and provenance; unsupported registration stays schematic.

Generate real storey elevations from supported values or explicitly attributed display spacing in the appropriate display unit. Stacked mode retains them; exploded mode adds spacing. Stair connectivity can use a continuous schematic ramp/flight between established storeys while recording unknown rise/vertical dimensions. Preserve source footprints and the larger terrace; do not introduce a connection from similarity alone. Export/reopen retains base elevation, relation and provenance. Source overlays inverse-transform actual reopened geometry, including building placement, to original coordinates.

Native scene floors derive from supplied storeys/containment even when storeys have no geometry. Missing/ambiguous containment remains visible without inventing a floor. Replace cutaway boolean with 0–100 slider: each selected floor uses its base elevation and supported height, or labeled display reference. In all-floor mode apply the same percentage independently to each storey's reference; uncontained geometry uses an explicitly displayed scene-wide reference. Use clipping planes in inspection and concept modes; do not rescale walls or move openings. Preserve percent, floor, mode, camera and selections across revision swaps.

Investigate wall/opening failures using retained descriptions, host keys, source segments, signed wall bands, transforms and actual reopened meshes. Structured local consistency findings identify duplicate/conflicting hosts, contradictory floor/stair relations, invalid projections and missing geometry, with source refs; they guide source review, not automatic nearest-wall snapping. If actual tapered walls need a richer representation, add optional source footprint polygons to the existing wall record and deterministic extrusion/void logic, retaining segment/band compatibility. Use real source evidence to distinguish extraction error from generator/display error.

- `GET /api/buildings` returns `{buildings:[document_public]}`. `GET /api/buildings/{id}` returns that public record plus saved jobs, newest first.
- `POST /api/buildings/{id}/reconstruction` accepts `{base_revision_id,mode:"refine"|"reconstruct"}` and returns a job with HTTP202. Genuine native IFC is never automatically reconstructed. - `GET /api/buildings/{id}/revisions/{revision}/evidence/{object_id}` returns a faithful native IFC record plus coverage for that exact saved revision, including non-rendered semantic records. Drawing-derived IFC is rejected on this native evidence path and continues to use original page regions.

- Portable artifact v4 preserves exact description, server-owned identities/tombstones and source frames. V2/V3 remain readable. Ordinary bbox changes cannot move frames; supported calibration/orientation changes require explicit evidence-backed updates. Concept proposals never enter these artifacts or reasoning records.

## Shared contracts (freeze before dependent implementation)

### Source identity and revision membership

A building keeps its existing 64-hex `building_id` (initial source hash); adding files never changes it. A `source_id` is SHA256 of original bytes, independent of filename. Source metadata includes original bytes/hash, display filename aliases, media kind, normalized page hashes/dimensions, normalization mapping/diagnostics and optional vector metadata. Deduplicate resources and successful interpretation by source identity, including reuse across buildings; do not reuse a source result conditioned on another building's context as independent extraction.

Each immutable revision saves a `sources` manifest. Entries map `(source_id, source_page)` to an append-only building `page` number, with the original normalized page pixels and coordinate mapping. Never renumber earlier pages. Internal `Page` and public page descriptors add `source_id`, `source_page` and source filename; existing `page` remains the canonical legacy selector. A source extraction cache uses source-local pages; merge explicitly remaps every source reference into the building page namespace and assigns building-stable object IDs. Geometry/review caches are keyed to their input revision, not merely original file hash.

References retain existing `{page,bbox}` and add optional `source_id`/`source_page`; server resolves legacy refs against that revision's manifest and rejects conflicting combinations. Every normalized bbox remains in the displayed original page frame, never the building frame. New evidence URLs are revision-pinned; existing unversioned routes remain compatibility/current routes. An older answer resolves its own source manifest, not CURRENT's source list. Legacy bundles synthesize one source entry on load without rewriting old revisions.

Native IFC keeps original GlobalId/property evidence per `source_id`; model record identity must include source identity when different IFCs repeat a GlobalId. Drawing-derived IFC restores drawing sources and cannot enter native factual shortcuts. Multi-source drawing ingestion is the main UI flow; mixed/native source catalogs retain per-record evidence rules rather than converting native objects to floor polygons. Never silently overwrite or fuse conflicting source facts.

### Shared interpretation with optional geometry

Extend `BuildingDescription` additively, not with a second incompatible reasoning pipeline. Retain floors, original labels, source refs and existing persistent IDs. Allow semantic records without geometric traces: empty/absent polygon/segment fields mean geometry unavailable, not empty evidence. Add source-linked observations/measurements for all view types, including section/elevation facts; only actual floor plans instantiate floor geometry. Expose extraction coverage and per-source completion. Preserve exact returned validated interpretation before any generator call.

Provider interface: `extract_interpretation(document, *, include_geometry=False)` returns the shared schema. The source-first prompt requests useful semantic observations, view classification, labels, measurements and evidence regions without exhaustive wall/feature polygon tracing. Geometry action reuses that interpretation and requests only missing geometry/relationships through the same schema and typed patch workflow; existing full descriptions require no re-extraction. Existing `reconstruct` may remain a compatibility wrapper. Reasoning object/floor records derive from saved interpretation independent of scene; optional scene associations enrich them without becoming factual evidence.

Source extraction operates independently per new source so adding B does not re-extract A. Building integration combines cached source interpretations deterministically; repeated views of a floor must not silently create additional storeys. Merge only source-supported floor equivalences, retain all supporting refs, and mark uncertain alternatives/conflicting dimensions explicitly. Explicit geometry/refinement can inspect multiple originals for cross-source relationships/conflicts. Persist interpretation identity/provenance and missing geometry; no geometry work or reconstruction review on default extraction. Missing interpretation records never establish missing source objects.

Revision payload adds `interpretation_status`, `geometry_status`, and `geometry_revision_id` where retained geometry belongs to an older interpretation. QA pins the current source/interpretation revision; UI explicitly identifies any retained older model, and highlights only validated associations. Publication of extraction must never relabel an older scene as regenerated against new evidence. Successful JSON survives a geometry error, restart or stop. ### Jobs, atomicity and APIs

# Chat-first UI coordination proposal

Status: proposed; backend routing implementation waits for main-session agreement.

UI worktree `/tmp/junction-chat-ui`, branch `feat/chat-first-ui`, base `fdfd4e3`. Main reliability worktree is read-only to this task. Focused UI commits only, no push.

## Shared action boundary

`POST /api/chat/actions` interprets and validates intent only. It does not run QA, save refinements, generate geometry, or introduce a job runner. The browser executes validated actions through existing operations.

Request: `{message,request_id,document_id?,revision_id?,workspace:{geometry_revision_id?,view_mode,selected_ids,focused_id,camera,tour,highlighting,show_assumptions}}`. View modes: chat/source/model/concept. Camera contains position, target and up; tour contains stable ordered IDs, index and running/paused state. Revision is current document/interpretation revision; geometry revision separately identifies the displayed saved model.

Submission synchronously pauses any tour and deep-captures workspace before awaiting interpretation. `this` refers to that captured focused ID. No screenshot or VLM rediscovery. Server uses authoritative saved catalog, never client labels/geometry as factual evidence. Model proposes selectors (focused, selected, kind, exact label/floor); application resolves and validates identities. Multiple matching labels produce focused clarification. A kind selector means all currently modeled matching objects, not exhaustive original extraction.

Result: `{request_id,document_id,revision_id,geometry_revision_id,status:ready|clarification,actions:[typed operation],message,clarification?}`. Typed operations cover question; open/model/source/chat/concept; select/focus; camera top/fit; tour start/pause/resume/next/previous; highlighting/assumptions toggles; floor/cutaway/explode/comparison; upload/append/open-saved/export; extraction/reconstruction/refine/stop; theme/help. Refinements carry the existing typed batch edit schema, with server-resolved floor/object scope and supplied values attributed to the user's message. No blanket confirmation. Unsupported/ambiguous values produce a clarification, not an inferred persistent edit. Exact enums/schema will be committed in `docs/CHAT_UI_CONTRACT.md` after plan review.

Navigation never calls factual QA. Natural language uses one configured-provider structured intent call; Gemini is default and explicit OpenAI remains supported with no failover. Compact in-chat controls can dispatch known typed navigation directly. Provider failures are operational failures, not insufficiency or regex-invented interpretations. Existing provider timeouts/settings apply; no extra retries or new model.

## Existing endpoints reused

- POST /api/documents; POST /api/buildings/{id}/sources; POST /api/buildings/{id}/extraction.
- GET /api/buildings and /api/buildings/{id}; GET saved scene/conversation/assumptions and revision-pinned pages/native evidence.
- POST /api/questions; GET /api/jobs/{id}; POST /api/jobs/{id}/stop.
- POST /api/buildings/{id}/reconstruction with existing base revision and mode.
- POST /api/buildings/{id}/refinements with existing attributed batch schema.
- Existing IFC download/export URL from document/scene.

## Progress, failures and revision handling

Chat shows “Reading your drawings…” during original save/extraction, source-ready separately from geometry-ready, meaningful existing job phases, and retained-model/review/partial failure status. No first upload auto-3D. Cached model is reused when requested. Accepted geometry swaps use existing atomic viewer replacement preserving camera/selection/settings, revalidated against new IDs. Missing/unresolved IDs retain source evidence but lose mesh highlights; never bind nearest replacements. A stale persistent action returns 409 and asks for reissue against current revision. A pending response cannot alter another document or a changed workspace. Source navigation uses captured geometry revision and exact saved source bbox; old citations retain their answered revision.

The UI will preserve main-session additive `recovery_events`, `submitted_values`, and event-base-revision source links. Rejected/failed/stopped refinement retains previous usable model and shows inputs/outcome. Source-only and failed geometry remain distinguishable from reviewed completion.

## Ownership

UI root owns docs and integration; frontend implementer owns app/static presentation/controller; viewer implementer owns app/static/viewer.js and deterministic viewer adapter/tests. Backend bounded implementer owns new app/chat_actions.py and tests/test_chat_actions.py plus minimal main.py route registration only after agreement. Avoid provider.py/openai_provider.py/jobs.py/revisions.py/QA/persistence/generator changes. Prefer additive interpreter using existing selected provider structured-call helpers. Any required provider integration change will be proposed first.

Chronicle theme source located: Programmercloud-cmd/AI_Chronicle_UI `src/web/styles/global.css`, blob `4396f7a3594369ea3a38c6c0ebdb620496f9703c`. Exact light/dark tokens will be copied with attribution.

## Main-session response

Please append agreement or requested interface changes here. Preliminary direct response approved additive chat_actions.py and narrow main.py registration; provider files are actively changing and must stay independent.

## Request and result

`POST /api/chat/actions` takes `{message,request_id,document_id:null|string,revision_id:null|string,workspace:{geometry_revision_id:null|string,view_mode:"chat|source|model|concept",selected_ids:[],focused_id:null|string,camera:null|object,tour:{ids:[],index:-1,running:false},navigation_epoch:0,highlighting:true,answer_highlighting:true,show_assumptions:false,floor_id:null|string,exploded:false,cutaway:100}}`.

Capture and deep-copy workspace synchronously at submit; pause timer before awaiting. A request does not accept client object names, source boxes or screenshots as evidence. `revision_id` means current interpretation; `geometry_revision_id` means displayed saved geometry. Camera uses viewer `getCameraState()`; damping is not a navigation epoch change. User submissions, compact navigation and manual viewer interaction invalidate older navigation responses. Polls and expected reconstruction swaps do not falsely invalidate their pending action.

Response echoes `request_id,document_id,revision_id,geometry_revision_id,navigation_epoch` and adds `{status:"ready|clarification",actions:[],message,clarification:null|{message,suggestions:[]},usage:{}}`. Message is a deterministic operation summary; factual output only comes from reviewed QA. Clarification concerns intent, never the evidence-sufficiency gate. Operational errors retain existing safe HTTP detail format; 409 means stale context. One selected-provider structured call, existing timeout/output budget, no retry/fallback. Known compact actions execute locally without interpretation.

## Typed actions

Every action has a literal `type`. Optional keys below default to null/empty. Unknown types/keys and invalid references fail validation.

| Type | Fields / behavior |
|---|---|
| `show_model` | Reuse cached scene or await existing reconstruction; preserve active tour. |
| `select` | `selector:{target:"focused|selection|all|named",kind:null|string,label:null|string,floor:null|string,ids:[]}`, server outputs `ids`, `unresolved_ids`, `deferred` (bool). Empty scene permits only semantic deferred selector; resolve after actual geometry arrives. No fabricated IDs. |
| `show_source` | Same optional `selector`; output `object_id`, `source`, `source_revision_id` from saved revision. Optional explicit `page` for whole original page. Focused references use captured geometry revision. Native source opens record inspector. |
| `close_workspace` | Retain model/camera/tour paused. |
| `set_camera` | `preset:"top|fit|isometric"`; preserve selections. |
| `tour` | `command:"start|pause|resume|next|previous"`; start uses navigation selected IDs, excludes unrenderable records. End stops without cycling. |
| `set_visibility` | `target:"answer_highlights|navigation_highlights|assumptions"`, `enabled:boolean`. Independent state. |
| `set_view` | `mode:"model|concept|source"`. |
| `set_floor` | `floor_id` resolved server-side, null means all; model may propose `label`. |
| `set_separation` | `enabled:boolean`. |
| `set_cutaway` | `percent:number` in existing 0–100 domain. |
| `set_theme` | `theme:"light|dark|system"`. Exact Chronicle tokens. |
| `question` | `question:string`; original message preserved for existing reviewed QA. |
| `refine` | `edits` is existing UserEdit batch, `supporting_source_ids:[]`; server validates with existing prepare_inputs without publication. Final execution sends existing RefinementRequest with current captured base. |
| `reconstruct` | `mode:"refine|reconstruct"`; reuse existing job route. |
| `list_saved` | Show saved choices in chat. |
| `open_saved` | `building_id` validated against saved catalog; model may propose `label`. |
| `attach_sources` / `new_upload` | Native file chooser from compact chat control. Existing upload/append routes. |
| `download_ifc` | Existing saved artifact URL; derived provenance unchanged. |
| `download_source` | `source_id` validated; ambiguity asks which source. |
| `retry_extraction` / `refresh` | Existing endpoints. |
| `stop_job` | `job_id` validated against selected building; ambiguity asks which job. |
| `inspect_assumptions` / `inspect_inventory` | Source-linked rows in chat, not a settings panel; no mesh for unresolved records. |
| `set_comparison` | `enabled:boolean`, optional `layer:"spaces|walls|openings|features|unresolved"`; toggles existing actual-IFC source overlay. |
| `help` | Compact examples and available operations in chat. |

Model selectors resolve exact saved IDs/labels/kinds/floors in code. Duplicate labels clarify. Saved modeled-window selection reports coverage as modeled records, not all real/source windows. Source boxes are copied unchanged; never synthesized tighter boxes. Focused removed objects retain old source evidence, but persistent edits must target current surviving identities. No nearest-object or list-index substitution.

Execute actions in order, stopping dependent actions on failure. A deferred selector waits for the explicitly requested reconstruction, then resolves using actual new scene records and checks the request/document/navigation epoch. Partial preview and failed review are reported honestly; no automatic extra reconstruction loop. Revision replacements use existing atomic viewer swap; revalidate tour IDs and pause/report lost targets. Source mode retains ordered IDs/index and model camera so back/next advances exactly once.

## Viewer interface

`getCameraState()` / `setCameraState(snapshot)`; `frameIds(ids,{topDown:false}) -> {framed_ids,unavailable_ids}`; `focusObject(id) -> {focused_id,orientation:"geometry|uncertain|unavailable",note}`; `setTheme("light|dark")`. Existing select, setHighlights, setHighlightsEnabled, setShowAssumptions, setFloorFilter, setExploded, setMode and cutaway methods remain. Geometry covariance can establish a window axis; it does not establish exterior side. Ambiguous axes use a labeled approximate oblique camera. Z-up orbit remains; top-down respects the existing numerical polar epsilon.

## Presentation and compatibility

Navigation turns/progress are ephemeral UI records retained across server conversation refresh, separate from persisted factual conversation. Answers are rendered once with citations and expandable existing checks. Saved building/job state remains backend-owned. Recovery events and submitted values are not evidence of publication: preserve labels and event.base_revision_id source pins. Failed/stopped/needs_attention outcomes retain usable models and original sources.

Chronicle tokens originate at `https://github.com/Programmercloud-cmd/AI_Chronicle_UI/blob/main/src/web/styles/global.css`, blob `4396f7a3594369ea3a38c6c0ebdb620496f9703c`: light background/surface/text/muted/line/accent/focus `#fbfaf8/#ffffff/#241f1a/#716a62/#ded9d2/#b95318/#1769aa`; dark `#121110/#191816/#eeeae4/#aaa39a/#403c37/#ef8a4c/#75bfff`.

Verification must distinguish explicit deterministic fixtures, actual imported artifacts/backend responses, and new live-provider runs. No fixture fallback in production. Full matrix in CHAT_UI_PLAN.md.
